patch_proposal.name: Suppress unnecessary executable code generation for proof-only checker closure
patch_proposal.change: Prefix each of these eight def declarations with noncomputable; preserve all binder/type/body bytes and every theorem/data packet.
patch_proposal.dependency: mcheckP <- mleafP <- leafStep <- node <- walkC/walk and node <- walkCut/walkCutR. Include callers to avoid later unsuccessful code-generation attempts.
patch_proposal.sdk_evidence: PreDefinition/Basic.lean134-140: code generated iff not theorem and not declaration modifier noncomputable; section controls logErrors only. Lines186-191 build the same kernel defnDecl; 217-223 add noncomputable environment tag and conditionally call compiler.
patch_proposal.preserve: Kernel bodies, reducibility hints, mathematical propositions, targets, states, cost/potential/graph data and all48 decide+kernel walks. No extra axiom/oracle or removal of numerical checks.
patch_proposal.exclude: ZeroForgePackedNat.digit64/decode64 and macro implementation must remain executable. Current candidate has no active native_decide, +native, #eval, evalExpr, evalConst or unsafe invocation consuming checker runtime code.
patch_proposal.limits: Not claimed to be the measured bottleneck or sufficient for official3200. No new execution authorized. Separate dead-consumer pruning is being independently assessed; this proposal should not require changing checker algorithms.
